ranked_candidates.title: MLAgentBench: Evaluating Language Agents on Machine Learning Experimentation
ranked_candidates.rationale: Direct task-level ML experimentation lineage; inspect small tabular/vision tasks and classifier source.

ranked_candidates.rationale: Integrated human-guided research system comparator and apparatus pattern, not itself a fixed task benchmark.

ranked_candidates.title: AI Research Preference Models
ranked_candidates.rationale: Allocation/candidate preference comparator; likely high GPU cost.

ranked_candidates.title: TraceML: An Empirical Analysis of Human-Agent Planning in Machine Learning Development
ranked_candidates.rationale: Real trajectory/process evidence for research decisions, not an account-free experimental task by itself.

selection_policy: Scientific task fit, source/data/scorer access, independent outcome and small-compute feasibility; no selection on anticipated G advantage. MLE-bench/PaperBench existing exact bytes reused separately.
